_comment: Operator safety net: symbols listed here are ALWAYS included in the scanner universe, even if the live BSE/NSE feeds fail to report a market cap (anti-bot blocking, stale BSE Mktcap, corporate actions). Add objects with {symbol, exchange, name}. market_cap_crore is an offline fallback only - a live NSE quote overrides it whenever available. Comment rows (empty symbol) are ignored.
